hook.name: MidasRWAHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for tokens paired with RWA quote assets (e.g. Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens). Charges a 1% steady-state fee split four ways: 0.35% to LPs, 0.35% accrued for GOLD buy-and-burn (sent to dead address), 0.22% to the pool deployer, and 0.08% as an immutable template royalty. An 8% launch surcharge decays linearly over 120 seconds, with a 1.5x multiplier on sells. Burn sweeps are rate-limited to once per hour with a 10% reference-price band and 3% slippage floor.
